name: Pushbullet
label: Pushbullet — Pushbullet API v2
description: Pushbullet via the official Pushbullet API v2. Base https://api.pushbullet.com/v2. Docs: https://docs.pushbullet.com/. Account token sees all devices. listen = websocket tickle is not opened — BPMN message events for inbound pushes. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Pushbullet operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"create-push"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: create-push | list-pushes | update-push | delete-push | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Push type for create-push. EXACT: note | link | file (link also needs url). Example: note.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Push title. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: body
schema.description: Push body. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: iden
schema.description: Push iden. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: url
schema.description: Link URL for create-push; required when type is link. Example: https://example.com/report.

schema.label: dismissed
schema.description: update-push: set true to mark the push dismissed (the only field Pushbullet lets you update). Example: true.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: create-push, list-pushes, update-push, delete-push, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Pushbullet access token. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
